attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Examiners for Counselors and Marriage and Family Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs accredited, approved or presented by AAMFT, American Association of Social Workers, AMA, APA, CRCC, Joint Commission, NBCC, SD Association/Board of Addiction and Prevention Professionals, SD Board of Examiners for Psychologists, SD Board of Social Work Examiners, SD Corrections Association, SD Counseling Association, SD Departments of Human Services and Social Services, and other states' counselor or MFT boards (or their state affiliates); others on request. Academic semester credit = 15 hours, quarter credit = 10. In-house programs max 8 hours; presentations/first-author publications max 10 hours each.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours are prorated in six-month increments for licensees first licensed during a cycle.
rules.audit_note: Verify CE under penalty of perjury at renewal; keep certificates 4 years after renewal; details on request if audited.
rules.notes: CE cycle runs December 1 of an even year to November 30 of the next even year. Courses may not be repeated in consecutive cycles.
